title: Try-a-Tri for Women: Getting Ready for the 2026 Edition of the Women's Tri-a-Tri Initiative
description: Join Rosie Dignam, Women's Officer of Sligo Triathlon Club, and Keirne McGowan, Secretary of Sligo Triathlon Club, as they discuss the Try-a-Tri initiative for women aged 35 and older. This 6-week training program is designed to help women get started with triathlon training and prepare for the actual triathlon event in September.
goals: Learn the basics of triathlon training
Gain confidence in swimming, cycling, and running
Meet and train with other women
